auditDefinitions.priority: A sufficiently specific public WCT statement exists before the comparison work.
auditDefinitions.convergence: A later independent work exhibits the same or a closely corresponding mechanism.
auditDefinitions.influence: Evidence that later authors encountered the earlier work; similarity alone does not establish influence.
auditDefinitions.priorArtGate: Older literature on generic ingredients is retained explicitly so established pre-WCT mechanisms are not attributed to WCT.

comparisonCorpus.status: The broader comparison corpus is undergoing source normalization and prior-art review; only the date-checked subset is promoted in this public registry.
